name: doki-wallpaper-carousel
description: Unofficial companion for the Doki Theme: flip your wallpaper through a folder of GIFs and images (PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, ...), choose where it shows (editors, side bars, panel, terminal), darken it live so code stays readable, color VS Code after it, make big GIFs lighter and turn .mp4 videos into GIF wallpapers.

dokiCarousel.folder.description: Folder containing the wallpapers (GIFs and images) to cycle through.

dokiCarousel.wallpaperOpacity.description: Opacity (%) of Doki's wallpaper over black: lower = darker, 100 = as the file is. Changes right away, without reopening the window, and never changes the files. Also adjustable with the Opacity slider in the Wallpaper Carousel panel, with w selected.

dokiCarousel.wallpaperTheme.description: Color VS Code with the palette of the wallpaper (or the background, see dokiCarousel.paletteSource), following it each time it changes. Turning it on replaces the current theme with VS Code's own dark theme, so Doki's colors don't mix in. Also the 'Theme from wallpaper' box in the Wallpaper Carousel panel.

enumDescriptions: The palette comes from Doki's wallpaper (doki.wallpaper.path)
The palette comes from Doki's background, the image of the empty editor (doki.background.path)
dokiCarousel.paletteSource.description: Which of Doki's two images gives its colors to VS Code when dokiCarousel.wallpaperTheme is on.

dokiCarousel.backgroundOpacity.description: Opacity (%) of Doki's background (the empty editor area) over black: lower = darker, 100 = as the file is. Changes right away. Also adjustable with the Opacity slider in the Wallpaper Carousel panel, with b selected.

dokiCarousel.includeSubfolders.description: Also look for images inside subfolders.

dokiCarousel.extensions.description: File extensions included in the carousel. The default is every format Doki can show (SVG and TIFF can't be shown).

dokiCarousel.sortBy.description: How files in the folder are ordered (the panel's Sort by list sets this and dokiCarousel.sortOrder).

dokiCarousel.sortOrder.description: asc = A to Z, oldest or smallest first; desc = the other way round.

enumDescriptions: doki.wallpaper.path: shows through the code, the side bars, the panel and the terminal
doki.background.path: fills the editor area only while no file is open
dokiCarousel.target.description: Which of Doki's two images the carousel changes. Applying one turns Doki's switch for it (doki.wallpaper.enabled / doki.background.enabled) on.

dokiCarousel.fixTerminalText.description: Keep terminal text readable over the wallpaper by setting terminal.integrated.gpuAcceleration to "off" (Doki's wallpaper hides the GPU renderer's text).

dokiCarousel.wallpaperInEditor.description: Show the wallpaper in the editor area (code, Welcome page, Settings, tabs). When off, a small CSS block hides it there; the window reopens to apply the change.

dokiCarousel.transparentTerminal.markdownDescription: Show the wallpaper behind the terminal text. When off, the terminal gets the theme's own background color (`terminal.background` in `workbench.colorCustomizations`).

dokiCarousel.transparentPanels.description: Make sideBar.background, sideBarSectionHeader.background and panel.background transparent so the wallpaper shows in both side bars, the bottom panel and the terminal tabs list.

dokiCarousel.quickInputTint.description: Darkness (%) of the tint behind the command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P). 0 = fully transparent, 100 = solid black. Also adjustable with the slider in the Wallpaper Carousel panel.

dokiCarousel.brightenThumbnails.description: Brighten the hover previews of dimmed wallpapers (blended with a dark background), so they are easier to recognize. Only the previews change, never the files.

dokiCarousel.showEditorTitleArrows.description: Show ← → arrows in the editor title bar.

dokiCarousel.showStatusBar.description: Show ◀ n/N ▶ controls in the status bar.

dokiCarousel.ffmpegPath.description: Folder containing ffmpeg and ffprobe (or the path to the ffmpeg executable). Empty = search the PATH and the usual install locations (Homebrew, apt, winget, scoop, ...).

dokiCarousel.converterScript.description: Optional: your own .ps1 converter taking the parameters of mp4_to_gif.ps1 (-Path, -Fps, -Width, ...). Runs with powershell.exe on Windows and pwsh (PowerShell 7) on macOS/Linux. Empty = built-in ffmpeg converter.

colors.description: Black layer over Doki's wallpaper. Set by the panel's Opacity slider (dokiCarousel.wallpaperOpacity); there is no need to change it by hand.
Black layer over Doki's background (the empty editor area). Set by the panel's Opacity slider (dokiCarousel.backgroundOpacity); there is no need to change it by hand.
